rules.sentence: Seborrheic dermatitis presents with erythema and greasy scaling on the scalp and face.
It tends to be distributed more in the nasolabial folds and hair-bearing areas of the face.
Keratosis pilaris rubra typically affects adolescent patients with tiny follicular papules of the lateral cheeks and neck on erythematous patches.
Flushing in rosacea is usually limited to the face.
Flushing that involves other areas warrants further attention.
